value.message: Kids & Me Drop-In at Halton Hills Public Library (Acton Branch) runs Thursdays 10:30-12 for families with kids up to 6, free, no registration - Halton Region's site says. There's also EarlyON in Acton & Georgetown for birth to 6, though their page doesn't list days or times. Want me to dig up EarlyON's schedule?
